cases.text: Ceiling Fan Efficiency: A weighted metric expressed in cubic feet per minute per watt.
Minimum High Speed Airflow: A test requirement reported in cubic feet per minute.
Spray force is measured in ounces under the required showerhead test.
The test examines spray coverage by collecting water in different concentric rings.
Maximum flow rate is measured in gallons per minute at specified pressures.
An Energy Magic Index (EMI) is marketed as the answer, but no independent test procedure exists.
A person may prefer a compact unit when their bathroom is small.
Pressure compensation is tested by checking minimum flow at several inlet pressure levels.
